HOW WE WORK

A standard readers can see.

Readers should be able to see where a claim comes from, what it means, and when it needs another look. These are the standards intended for the future publication.

EDITORIAL COMMITMENT

Show sources and limits clearly. Label commercial material. Correct meaningful errors.

01

Sources and verification

Use checkable primary material where relevant. Attribute figures, explain assumptions, and distinguish established information from interpretation.

02

Authors and review

Show the writer and any relevant reviewer with an accurate biography. Do not imply professional qualifications that have not been verified.

03

Updates and corrections

Show publication and update dates. Correct material errors clearly and review time-sensitive information when it changes.

04

Commercial separation

Label sponsored content and advertising. Keep commercial placements visually distinct from editorial stories.
